register_custom_measure: register a new Habitat measure class with reset_metric and update_metric methods for episode tracking
register_custom_sensor: register a new Habitat sensor class with get_observation to return agent position data
create_measure_config: create a MeasurementConfig dataclass with typed fields to configure a custom Habitat measure
create_sensor_config: create a LabSensorConfig dataclass with typed fields and MISSING defaults for a custom Habitat sensor
run_env_with_custom_sensors: run a Habitat environment with custom sensors and measures added via config and read metrics
